reasons.claim: Notification is a 3.19 ha polygon (Föryngringsavverkning, Falun), status 'Anmält för avverkning'.
No completed felling overlaps the polygon (0%).
No species records inside or within 250 m; no eligible species and no site-bound forest NT species reported in any ring per the rubric hint.
Effort within 1000 m is 71 records, 67 species, 4 observation days, just above the county median of 66 (52nd percentile), so the rubric gives LOW.

uncertainties: Effort is only marginally above the county median (71 vs 66) and comes from just 4 observation days, so the LOW margin is thin.
Near-site effort is 0 records inside and within 250 m (county median within 250 m is 3), so nothing has been recorded on or next to the polygon itself.
not_established: LOW is not 'safe to fell'; absence of records is not absence of species.
Hidden or coordinate-obscured sensitive species would not appear in public data.
No ecological survey of the stand is implied by this evidence.
next_action: Low-priority for human ecological review; if reviewer capacity allows, note that the polygon has no nearby records and consider a quick check of the stand before the felling start date (normally at least six weeks after 2026-10-02).
